optimization.heading: AI appointment optimization
optimization.intro: The AI rearranges your appointments so that fewer kilometres and less driving time are needed. Every move is only applied once you confirm it.

rules.title: How the AI plans
rules.window: Only appointments at least {minLeadDays} days ahead are moved, and the AI keeps an eye on the next {horizonDays} days.
rules.locked: Fixed appointments and completed appointments stay untouched.
rules.recurring: Recurring appointments are moved by at most {maxRecurringShiftDays} days.
rules.travel: Every proposal leaves enough driving time and buffer to the previous and the next appointment.

launch.title: Start optimization
launch.running: The AI is planning your appointments …
launch.lastRun: Last run: {analyzed} appointments checked, {candidates} possible moves assessed, {proposals} proposals.
launch.noProposals: The AI found no move that saves driving time or kilometres.
launch.error: The optimization could not be started.

confirm.message: A run calls the Claude API and usually costs about 0.5 to 2 cents. Start now?
